# SurfUp

> Automated surfboard rental stations in Hawaii and San Diego. Rent a surfboard 24/7 with the SurfUp app.

SurfUp operates self-service SurfPod stations at beaches, resorts, and campuses. Customers download the app, scan a board, and surf. No reservations, no staff, available around the clock.
